title: Prediction and betting odds for Clippers vs. Thunder
text:
Prediction and betting odds for Clippers vs. Thunder Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter OKC THUNDER Prediction and betting odds for Clippers vs. Thunder
 Clemente Almanza OKC Thunder Wire Oct. 25, 2026, 7:02 a.m. CT The  Oklahoma City Thunder  play the  LA Clippers on Sunday, and if you’re looking to do some last-minute betting research, you’re in luck! We’ll give you the latest point spread, money line odds and over/under number, as well as the information you’ll need to make the smartest bet.
 This is the first matchup between the two squads in the 2026-27 regular season. This is also the first night of a back-to-back for OKC.
 The Thunder (2-0) are off to a superb start. They had an ugly 96-84 win over the Denver Nuggets in their home opener on Thursday. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander saw his historic 20-point streak end as he had just 17 points on 6-of-19 shooting.
 Meanwhile, the Clippers (1-1) had a 125-117 loss to the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday. Darius Garland went off for 26 points and six assists. Brook Lopez also had a throwback-esque 22 points off the bench.
 The lines, courtesy of BetMGM
 Point spread: Thunder -14.5
 Money line: Clippers +700 / Thunder -1100
 Over-under: 221.5
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Clippers vs. Thunder injury updates
 Thunder: Nikola Topic (back surgery) is out. Thomas Sorber (back surgery) is out. Otega Oweh (torn Achilles) is out.
 Clippers: Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) is out. Bradley Beal (knee surgery management) is out. Max Strus (torn plantar fascia) is out. Yanic Konan Niederhauser (Lisfranc injury) is out. Jordan Miller (torn rotator cuff) is out.
 Probable starting lineups
 Oklahoma City Thunder 
 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
 Cason Wallace
 Jalen Williams
 Chet Holmgren
 Isaiah Hartenstein
 LA Clippers 
 Darius Garland
 Kris Dunn
 Rui Hachimura
 Derrick Jones Jr.
 Isaiah Jackson
 Advice and prediction
 I know their first two games were double-digit wins, but this should be the first stress-free win of the year for the Thunder. The Clippers are on the opposite side of the NBA highway. You're seeing the top title contender and a recent rebuild go at it. This should be a game where it's over by halftime and the OKC starters sit out the fourth quarter. Take care of business here. Especially since it's the start of a back-to-back. No need to tax your legs this early in the marathon.
 Prediction:  Thunder 115, Clippers 97
